common.tagline: Where your child's day away from home lives.

landing.metaTitle: ANCHOR, Daily updates. Safety you can trust.
landing.metaDescription: Voice-powered daily reports for childcare programs. One timeline for parents. Incidents documented when it matters.
landing.heroTitle: Daily updates. Safety you can trust.
landing.heroSubtitle: Voice-powered reports for staff. One timeline for parents. Incidents documented when it matters.
landing.previewBody: Emma had a great day exploring sensory play, ate all of lunch, and napped 90 minutes. She was cheerful at pickup time.
landing.audienceSubtitle: ANCHOR connects programs and families with clarity, daily stories for parents, efficient reporting for staff.
landing.audienceParentsBody: See your child's day in one timeline, photos, voice reports, notes, and safety alerts without chasing staff at pickup.
landing.audienceProgramsBody: Publish polished daily reports in minutes, grow parent adoption, and document incidents with an audit trail directors trust.
landing.homeStepsSubtitle: From first invite to daily rhythm, built for real childcare workflows.
landing.homeStep1Body: Directors set up classrooms, teams, or camps and invite coaches and families.
landing.homeStep2Body: Coaches record voice notes; ANCHOR drafts reports for quick review and publish.
landing.homeStep3Body: Families receive a single timeline per child, calm, complete, and always in the loop.
landing.homeStep4Body: Incidents, care notes, and adoption insights build retention for programs and peace of mind for parents.
landing.bentoTimelineBody: Photos, voice reports, notes, and incidents, organized by child, not scattered across apps.
landing.bentoVoiceBody: Coaches record a quick voice note; ANCHOR drafts a polished daily report for review before publish.
landing.bentoSafetyBody: Structured incident flows, parent alerts, and an audit trail, documented the moment it matters.
landing.bentoProgramsBody: Classrooms, teams, and camps manage roster, coaches, and parent adoption from one dashboard.
landing.bentoSectionTitle: Everything families need, without another app to babysit.
landing.bentoProgramsHighlight: Directors see adoption. Coaches publish in minutes. Parents feel present.
landing.trustQuote: Parents shouldn't have to chase updates. Programs shouldn't lose an hour to end-of-day paperwork.
landing.trustAttribution: Designed with directors who run premium childcare and youth programs.
landing.homeFaq1Q: Does ANCHOR replace our current childcare software?
landing.homeFaq1A: No. ANCHOR works alongside tools like Brightwheel or TeamSnap. We own the daily story, safety documentation, and parent communication layer.
landing.homeFaq2A: Programs invite parents when a child is enrolled. Parents create an account and immediately see their child's timeline.
landing.homeFaq3Q: How long does setup take for a program?
landing.homeFaq3A: Most programs publish their first report within the first week, roster import, coach onboarding, and parent invites are guided in-app.
landing.homeFaq4A: Incidents follow structured forms with timestamps, notifications, and audit logs. Programs remain responsible for their regulatory obligations.
landing.homeFaq5Q: Can we use ANCHOR for sports and camps too?
landing.homeFaq5A: Yes. Programs, rosters, and parent timelines work for daycare, sports teams, and seasonal camps with the same engine.
landing.homeReferralTitle: Know a program that still sends paper notes?
landing.homeReferralBody: Refer a director or owner. When they launch with ANCHOR, we'll credit your account and help them onboard families in week one.
landing.homeReferralNote: Referral credits apply after the referred program completes onboarding.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Programs invest in communication. Parents upgrade when the timeline becomes indispensable.
landing.pricingProgramsDescription: 14-day free trial. Unlimited programs, coaches, and parent invites.
landing.pricingParentsDescription: Full timeline history, care tools, and multi-child management for every program your family uses.
landing.pricingParentsFeature2: Full timeline history and PDF export
landing.pricingFootnote: Parents join free when invited by their program. Family unlocks extended history and care features.
landing.ctaBandTitle: Give families a day they can see.
landing.ctaBandSubtitle: Start with your programs, invite parents, and publish the first report this week.
landing.footerTagline: Where your child's day away from home lives.

parentsPage.metaDescription: One timeline for your child's day away from home. Photos, voice reports, safety alerts, and care, without chasing updates.
parentsPage.heroTitle: Feel present, even when you can't be there.
parentsPage.heroSubtitle: ANCHOR gives you a single, calm timeline for every program your child attends. No more fragmented texts, lost paper notes, or guessing at pickup.
parentsPage.painSubtitle: Premium programs promise communication. Parents still end up piecing together the day from scraps.
parentsPage.pain1Body: Texts, email, paper sheets, and separate apps, none of it organized by child or by day.
parentsPage.pain2Body: You arrive hoping for a full picture, but staff are rushing and details get lost in the handoff.
parentsPage.pain3Body: When something happens, you need clarity fast, not a vague note hours later.
parentsPage.stepsSubtitle: From invite to daily rhythm in minutes.
parentsPage.step1Body: Your program adds your child and sends a secure invite to create your parent account.
parentsPage.step2Body: Add children, emergency contacts, and authorized pickups once, used across every program.
parentsPage.step3Body: Photos, voice reports, and notes arrive in one feed, newest first, always per child.
parentsPage.step4Body: Incident alerts and care updates reach you immediately, with full context and history.
parentsPage.featuresTitle: Built for how parents actually live
parentsPage.featuresSubtitle: Calm, complete, and respectful of your time.
parentsPage.feature1Body: Every photo, report, and note in chronological order, no digging through threads.
parentsPage.feature2Body: Staff record naturally; you receive polished summaries you can scan in seconds.
parentsPage.feature3Body: Structured alerts with what happened, what was done, and who was notified.
parentsPage.feature4Body: Allergies, medications, and authorized pickups always available to program staff.
parentsPage.feature5Body: Doctor directory, visit records, and consult requests when health questions arise.
parentsPage.feature6Body: Switch between children instantly, each with their own timeline and alerts.
parentsPage.retentionSubtitle: ANCHOR becomes the daily habit, not another notification to ignore.
parentsPage.retention1Body: A calm summary of the week lands in your inbox, highlights without the noise.
parentsPage.retention2Body: Subscription unlocks extended timeline history, care tools, and multi-child management.
parentsPage.retention3Body: You are included in every child-related communication, no side channels, ever.
parentsPage.pricingSubtitle: Join free when your program invites you. Upgrade when you want full history and care tools.
parentsPage.conversionSubtitle: Sign in to see today's updates. Waiting for an invite? Ask your director to add your family.
parentsPage.referralTitle: Love what you see? Bring ANCHOR to your program.
parentsPage.referralBody: If your child's school, team, or camp doesn't use ANCHOR yet, refer the director. We'll help them launch and credit your Family account.
parentsPage.referralNote: Referral rewards apply after the program completes onboarding.
parentsPage.faq1Q: I didn't receive an invite, what do I do?
parentsPage.faq1A: Ask your program director to confirm your email is on the roster. Invites are sent when your child is enrolled in a program.
parentsPage.faq2Q: Can both parents access the same child?
parentsPage.faq2A: Yes. Programs can link multiple guardians to one child, each with their own login.
parentsPage.faq3A: Only authorized program staff and linked parents see your child's timeline. We never sell personal data.
parentsPage.faq4Q: What if my child attends multiple programs?
parentsPage.faq4A: Each enrollment appears in your app. Switch children and programs from one profile.
parentsPage.faq5A: You receive an immediate notification with structured details. Full incident history stays in the timeline.
parentsPage.finalCtaTitle: Your child's day, in one place.
parentsPage.finalCtaSubtitle: Create your account or sign in to see today's updates.

programsPage.metaDescription: Voice-powered daily reports, parent adoption analytics, and incident documentation for daycare, sports, and camps.
programsPage.heroTitle: Publish the day in minutes. Earn trust for years.
programsPage.heroSubtitle: ANCHOR helps directors and coaches deliver premium parent communication, without losing an hour to end-of-day paperwork.
programsPage.painTitle: Premium programs still lose hours to reporting
programsPage.painSubtitle: Parents expect more. Staff are stretched. Incident risk never sleeps.
programsPage.pain1Body: Coaches stay late writing notes while parents wait for updates that never feel complete.
programsPage.pain2Body: You invest in communication tools, but families disengage when updates feel generic or scattered.
programsPage.pain3Body: When incidents happen, handwritten notes and memory are not enough for directors or regulators.
programsPage.stepsSubtitle: From signup to first published report, guided at every step.
programsPage.step1Body: Set up programs, classrooms, or teams and invite coaches with role-based access.
programsPage.step2Body: Add children, link parents, and send invites, registrations and waivers in one flow.
programsPage.step3Body: Voice notes become polished reports. Review, edit, and publish before pickup.
programsPage.step4Body: Track which parents open reports and nudge families who haven't connected yet.
programsPage.featuresSubtitle: One codebase. Coach app included. Built for scale.
programsPage.feature1Body: Coaches speak naturally; ANCHOR drafts per-child reports for review, minutes, not hours.
programsPage.feature2Body: Adoption rates, today's activity, trial status, and program health at a glance.
programsPage.feature3Body: Structured forms, parent alerts, audit logs, and export-ready documentation.
programsPage.feature4Body: Same platform, restricted role, assigned programs only, no billing or admin access.
programsPage.feature5Body: Upload photos and videos, tag children, and notify parents automatically.
programsPage.feature6Body: Reach all parents in a program with announcements, parents always in the thread.
programsPage.retentionSubtitle: ANCHOR Pro pays for itself in parent satisfaction and staff time saved.
programsPage.retention1Body: See who opens reports and which programs need outreach, before renewal conversations.
programsPage.retention2Body: Staff publish faster, stay longer with families at pickup, and feel less burned out.
programsPage.retention3Body: Directors sleep better knowing every incident is documented the moment it happens.
programsPage.pricingSubtitle: One subscription per organization. Unlimited programs, coaches, and parent invites.
programsPage.conversionTitle: Ready to publish your first report?
programsPage.conversionSubtitle: Create your program account, invite one coach, and send your first parent invite today.
programsPage.referralTitle: Refer another program. Both of you win.
programsPage.referralBody: Know a director running daycare, sports, or camps? Refer them to ANCHOR. When they launch, you receive account credit and priority onboarding support.
programsPage.referralNote: Credits apply after referred program completes onboarding.
programsPage.faq1A: Programs subscribe to ANCHOR Pro based on active programs and roster size. Parents can subscribe to ANCHOR Family for extended features.
programsPage.faq2A: Most coaches publish their first voice report within 15 minutes. In-app guides cover roster, media, and incidents.
programsPage.faq3A: Yes. One organization can manage classrooms, teams, and camps with separate rosters and coaches.
programsPage.faq4A: Role-based access, encrypted transport, and audit logs. Programs control who sees each child's information.
programsPage.faq5A: ANCHOR Pro billing is in-app. Program registration payments and marketplace features are on the roadmap.
programsPage.finalCtaTitle: Give families a day they can see.
programsPage.finalCtaSubtitle: Start free setup, publish your first report this week.

supportPage.metaDescription: Get help with ANCHOR, contact our team, browse parent and program FAQs, or report a safety concern.
supportPage.heroTitle: We're here when you need us.
supportPage.heroSubtitle: Whether you're a parent waiting for an invite or a director launching your first report, our team responds within one business day.
supportPage.channel1Body: Account questions, billing, onboarding help, and technical issues, reach us directly.
supportPage.channel2Body: Invites, timelines, incident alerts, and family account setup.
supportPage.channel3Body: Roster setup, coach onboarding, voice reports, and incident documentation.
supportPage.safetySubtitle: If something urgent happened involving a child in care, contact your program director first, then reach us if you need platform assistance.
supportPage.safetyBody: ANCHOR provides structured incident flows and parent alerts, but programs remain responsible for immediate care decisions. For platform-related safety documentation questions, email us with your program name and child reference (no sensitive details in email subject lines).

legal.privacyIntro: ANCHOR respects your privacy. This page summarizes how we handle information for parents, programs, and staff using the platform.
legal.privacyBody: We collect account details, child program information, and content you upload (such as photos and daily reports) to provide the service. We do not sell personal data. Contact us at hello@anchor.care for privacy requests.
legal.termsIntro: By using ANCHOR, programs and parents agree to use the platform responsibly and in compliance with applicable childcare and data protection laws.
legal.termsBody: ANCHOR provides software for daily communication and documentation. Programs remain responsible for their care obligations, consent processes, and regulatory compliance. Service terms may be updated with notice to account holders.
